Kerala Cleric's Remarks on Women Spark Controversy

Grand Mufti Sheikh Abubakr Ahmad, also known as Kanthapuram AP Aboobacker Musliyar, has sparked a row with his recent statement. He reportedly said that women appearing on public platforms would lead to "great destruction" and that they "should stay at home." The remarks were made in Kerala.
